parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the top control part of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting to adjust the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt depending on the faucet design to regulate water output.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main structural body of the faucet, providing support and housing for internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout and switch, ensuring water flows properly through the internal piping.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable base for the other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the outlet part of the faucet through which water flows out, made of stainless steel for hygiene and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream into the sink or basin, often designed with an aerator for smooth flow.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel in some designs to direct water flow but is typically fixed in smaller faucets.
